notes: LTspice-style 4-terminal symbols: body (arrow) terminal of M1 and M2 is wired to the common tail node; M3, M4, M6 bodies to Vdd; M5, M7 bodies to GND.
Top terminal of each PMOS (M3, M4, M6) goes to Vdd and is taken as Source; top terminal of each NMOS is taken as Drain.
M3 is diode-connected (gate wire joins its drain node n1, which is also M1 drain); M4 gate is on n1.
Rc left end joins the M2/M4 drain node n2 at a dot; that node also drives the M7 gate via the vertical wire at x~0.84.
The Vin+ gate wire of M2 crosses the n2-to-M7-gate vertical wire with no dot: read as not connected.
Net names n1, n2, tail, nrc assigned by reader; Vdd/GND/Vin-/Vin+/Vout/V_REF1/V_REF2 are figure labels (lowercased).
Stimulus (Fig. 3 / Sec. III): differential input 4mV peak-to-peak, 10Hz; no input sources added because their DC level is absent.
Paper reports for 180nm: DC gain 60.86 dB, PM 63.5 deg, UGB 27.54 kHz, power 107.88 nW; Table III lists ID1,2 = 7.423nA, ID6,7 = 200.9nA.
